svg.text: unbucketize_permute reverses row-wise communication order; reverse_indices reverses deduplication. They are not interchangeable.
The eight gather launches [96-103] are tiles of one logical reverse-index gather over the large embedding tensor.
Activity IDs, sizes, kernel names and optimizer details illustrate one execution configuration; they are not fixed for every run.
